basis: The dashboard visually encodes the 2014 population shares for 0-14 years and 65 years + with explicit numeric labels at the 2014 x-axis tick: 14.82% for 0-14 years and 20.1% for 65 years +. The task requires comparing these shares and opening the follow-up record for the group with the larger share. Since 20.1% > 14.82%, the 65 years + group has the larger 2014 share. The option to open the 2014 65 years + aging-services planning follow-up record is therefore the correct choice.
option_label: Open 2014 65 years + aging-services planning follow-up record
